patches_added.name: Vibration slider everywhere
patches_added.description: Forces Gboard to show its own vibration strength slider on every device, rather than deferring to the system haptic settings page, so the strength is adjustable instead of being fixed by whichever rollout the device landed in.

patches_modified.name: Swipe Right to Undo
patches_modified.description: Swipe right after deleting to put the words back — the swipe starts on the Delete key, or anywhere when Swipe to Delete is also applied. Uses Gboard's own undo, which already records what a delete swipe removed.

patches_added.name: Change Facebook app theme (573)
patches_added.description: Adds AMOLED Black and Material You palettes while preserving Facebook's light/dark mode selection.

patches_added.name: Facebook 573 AI content diagnostics
patches_added.description: Logs Facebook GenAI structural flags for Feed stories without filtering them.

patches_added.name: Facebook 573 AI filter + recommendation diagnostics
patches_added.description: Filters detected AI Feed stories and logs structural metadata for DiscoverFeedUnit recommendation candidates in one bytecode injection.

patches_added.name: Facebook 573 Feed recommendation diagnostics
patches_added.description: Logs structural metadata for injected Feed stories without filtering them.

patches_added.name: Hide Facebook AI content (573)
patches_added.description: Filters Feed posts carrying Facebook's GenAI transparency metadata (Contenido de IA).

patches_modified.name: Disable Infinite Upgrade Popup
patches_modified.description: Disables the "Want unlimited access? Get Sankaku Infinite!" upsell popup that periodically appears while browsing the app.

patches_modified.name: Disable Infinite Upgrade Popup
patches_modified.description: Disables the "Want unlimited access? Get Sankaku Infinite!" upsell popup that periodically appears while browsing the app.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.

patches_modified.name: Hide upgrade upselling
patches_modified.description: Hides the top-bar upgrade button and promotional sidebar rows.

patches_modified.name: Remove 'Sent from' signature
patches_modified.description: Removes the 'Sent from Proton Mail' signature from emails.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature
patches_modified.description: Restores push notifications by spoofing the original app signature.

patches_modified.name: Unlock custom time picker
patches_modified.description: Enables picking a custom date and time when snoozing conversations and scheduling messages.

patches_removed.name: Video dither
patches_removed.description: Enables or disables VRLink video dithering, including the highp sRGB8 fallback and experimental RGB10_A2 shader variants.

patches_modified.name: Device identity
patches_modified.description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR. Recommended selects Meta Quest Pro for exact legacy bundle targets through 5002244, including 2.0.20/5001712; otherwise Galaxy XR. The Galaxy profile installs its complete transport identity while preserving stock controller/hand routing and extensions.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR legacy foundation (through 2.0.22/5002244)
patches_modified.description: Selects the 16-patch Galaxy XR legacy set, including Meta Quest Pro identity, native gates, face bridge, OLED calibration, microphone, battery, Visual Delay, and XR foundation. High-resolution output is guarded to verified layouts; unavailable on 5001740, 5002172, and 5002206.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.20/5001712)
patches_modified.description: Applies the 16-patch Galaxy XR legacy set for exact Steam Link 2.0.20 build 5001712, including Meta Quest Pro identity, permission-free high resolution, and the Final balanced tested OLED profile.
